headline: Hormel Foods Completes Sale of CERATTI® Business in Brazil
summary: Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE: HRL), a Fortune 500 global branded food company, today announced the successful completion of the sale of its Brazilian operations, operated under the CERATTI® brand, to Zanchetta Alimentos LTDA, a Brazilian food company with an established presence in the market.

headline: Hormel: Why This Dividend Aristocrat Is Still A 'Buy'
